title: Red Hat Security Advisory: kernel security update
description: A critical security vulnerability (CVE-2026-98432) affecting the Linux kernel in Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8 has been addressed. The flaw involves improper freeing of inet_opt and ireq_opt after an RCU grace period in the IPv4 networking code. Red Hat has released a security update to fix this issue. The update requires a system reboot to take effect. Red Hat emphasizes the importance of applying kernel updates promptly due to the kernel's fundamental role in system security.
